title: Fix Arc Preview and Output
description: The arc command doesn't preview correctly (no curve rendering for arc/circle-outline preview kinds) and produces wrong output (kernel reads radiusPoint instead of start)
summary:
Fixed multi-pane puzzle 2d selection desync when clearing or changing selection after a marquee.

Root cause: peer panes kept stale area-select `preselect` while committed `selection` was updated, so `preselect \ selection` still painted selected chrome on other windows.

- `applySelectionFromPeerSilent`: clear peer preselect when mirroring committed selection.
- `updateSelection`: broadcast empty preselect to peers when ending a committed select gesture.
- Playground `applyCanvasSelection`: call `puzzle2dSyncSelectionToAllAuthoringPeers` like hierarchy `setSelectionIds`.
- Added regression tests for preselect clear + background deselect across peers. All 115 puzzle/2d/react tests pass.
